grades.3: the document answers the question on its own
grades.2: strongly supporting: needed context or a second valid answer
grades.1: partially relevant: adjacent topic a reviewer would not call wrong

notes: Relevance is graded at document level; retrieval returns chunks, so every
chunk of a graded document inherits its grade. That is deliberate: the
product question is 'did the agent get the right policy document into the
prompt', and chunk-level qrels over a 24-document corpus would be noise.
These queries are the EVALUATION set. The reranker trains on
data/eval/reranker_labels.jsonl, whose query strings are disjoint from
this file, so no number reported here was fitted on.
Queries q45-q50 have empty qrels on purpose: they are the ABSTENTION set, all
near-misses whose salient terms do occur in the corpus (refunds, integrations,
billing, hours) while no document answers the actual question. Ranking metrics
are undefined for them, so voice_agent.evals.retrieval_metrics excludes them
from every mean and the gated operating point scores them as refusals instead.
